children: Beijing might favor a gradual yuan appreciation, according to Goldman Sachs in a note. Beijing's stated economic policy objectives include further growth in high-tech sectors to "build a manufacturing superpower" and "self-reliance" in key inputs and technologies, and increased internationalization of the renminbi, GS says. "We anticipate China's policymakers will continue to favor gradual Chinese yuan appreciation against the U.S. dollar (3-5%/year) as the option that best balances these objectives," GS says. (tracy.qu@wsj.com)
